name: Star Trek Legends: Enemies & Allies Content Pack
summary:
Boldly venture into the unknown in this thrilling new DLC, where the fabric of time itself is at stake! In the Enemies and Allies Content Pack featuring The Two Noble Cardassians storyline, the past and present collide as you navigate the enigmatic forests of Kwejian.

Embark on six action-packed missions as you unravel hidden truths, uncover Cardassian motivations, and forge alliances that could tip the balance of power. Face off against formidable adversaries while unlocking iconic characters like Cleveland Booker, Captain Michael Burnham, Kruge, and Damar. Each comes equipped with unique special abilities to turn the tide of battle.

Adventure, mystery, and Starfleet's finest await. Do you have what it takes to uphold the mission, or will time unravel before your very eyes?
